**GameKeepr** — your game servers, your friends' hands.
A self-hosted portal for the game servers on your Unraid box. Friends sign in, see which servers are up and who is playing, and restart a server when a game update lands — without touching Unraid, SSH, or anything else on the machine.
What it does: restarts verified against the game itself (not just the container), installing servers from Community Applications templates or any of ~580 dedicated servers on Steam, schedules that skip when players are online, world backups with safe restores, live logs with a console that types at the game, mod installs with archive-safety checks and optional malware scanning, three roles with per-server exceptions, Discord notifications, and a built-in wiki that documents all of it.
Honest by design: the container mounts the Docker socket (root-equivalent — the overview and the documentation say so prominently), never deploys privileged containers, and never lets a request name a container directly.
Documentation and screenshots: https://kengoossens.github.io/Gamekeep/ Support: the forum thread below. Bugs and code: GitHub.
